title: Pre-CVE Advisory: Proxy Credential Leak in Requests & OpenSSL TLS Parsing Flaw
summary: Pre-CVE advisory covering proxy credential leak in Python requests < 2.31.0 and memory flaw in Debian openssl < 1.1.1n-0+deb11u5.
details: Bundled offline demonstration advisory illustrating deterministic quote grounding, generic-name blocking, OSV compilation, and SBOM matching.

claims.evidence_quote: Python requests versions prior to 2.31.0 when handling HTTP redirects
Debian openssl versions before 1.1.1n-0+deb11u5 on Debian 11 systems
An unrelated internal utils helper was also audited with no impact.
